item_name: Rothco U.S. Flag Multi-Use Tactical Wrap

With its ability to transform into multiple styles—bandana, neck gaiter, dust screen, balaclava, scarf, or hat—this wrap offers flexibility for any activity. Made from durable and lightweight 100% polyester material, the tactical wrap is both breathable and moisture-wicking, keeping you comfortable during any weather condition.
description: Rothco’s U.S. Flag Multi-Use Tactical Wrap is a highly versatile piece of headwear designed to provide comfort and protection in various outdoor environments. With its ability to transform into multiple styles—bandana, neck gaiter, dust screen, balaclava, scarf, or hat—this wrap offers flexibility for any activity. Made from durable and lightweight 100% polyester material, the tactical wrap is both breathable and moisture-wicking, keeping you comfortable during any weather condition. It also provides resistance against wind, making it ideal for outdoor sports, work, or everyday wear. Featuring a sleek black and white U.S. flag design, this multi-use wrap adds a touch of style while ensuring practical functionality. Whether you’re out hiking, biking, or just needing an extra layer of protection, Rothco’s U.S. Flag Tactical Wrap is a must-have accessory for any outdoor enthusiast. The wrap measures 19.5 inch x 10 inch, delivering a snug fit for most head sizes.
